purpose: Prioritize compounding capability improvements rather than adding disconnected subsystems.

priorities.goal: Use seven-layer Story DNA and Story Curator to organize events before writing.
priorities.successMetric: Fewer mixed-topic articles and stronger first-pass body coherence.

priorities.goal: Improve drafts before editorial review using technique registry, lexicon, headline memory, and story DNA.
priorities.successMetric: First-pass acceptance rises while repair count falls.

priorities.goal: Turn validation into guided improvement with repair routing and prevention learning.
priorities.successMetric: Second-pass approval and repair success increase.

priorities.goal: Measure lexicon utilization and contextual word-choice impact, not vocabulary size.
priorities.successMetric: Lexicon utilization rises and repeated phrase rate falls.

priorities.goal: Report whether behavior changed and whether improvements measurably worked.
priorities.successMetric: Lessons applied, behavior changed, failures prevented.

priorities.goal: Ensure each repair teaches Writer, Dossier, Editor, Validator, Publisher, and collectors as needed.
priorities.successMetric: Same rejection categories decline across future cycles.

rule: Each improvement must propagate across the platform and prove changed behavior, not just create another memory record.

articleIntelligenceEngine.goal: Make every draft begin from a complete narrative and reader plan.
articleIntelligenceEngine.rule: Before drafting, Article Intelligence creates a reader-centered narrative plan. Writing begins only after the story, reader value, arc, evidence, headline direction, and ending direction are known.

newCapabilities.name: Historical Context Engine
newCapabilities.purpose: Score and package materially relevant historical context before the Story Dossier reaches the Writer.
newCapabilities.maturityTarget: Articles explain relevant background and causal history without generic filler, topic drift, or unfair implication.

newCapabilities.name: Lexicon Public Reference Policy
newCapabilities.purpose: Permit dictionary, thesaurus, encyclopedia, and style-reference learning for meaning and usage while prohibiting copied phrasing.
newCapabilities.maturityTarget: Better vocabulary precision and lower repetition without copying reference-source expression.

newCapabilities.name: Reasoning Memory Graph
newCapabilities.purpose: Connect decisions, reasons, outcomes, improvements, and future confidence across Framework subsystems.
newCapabilities.maturityTarget: Behavioral adaptation based on why prior decisions worked or failed.
